decisions.statement: A readout whose last take answered a number carries nothing here.
The first take to answer nothing writes this.
The takes after leave this as it is.
This is taken away by the take that answers a number again.
A watch that has taken a readout no time yet reads it as answering nothing.
Answering nothing is a fact about a readout rather than a fault of its watch.

definition: when a readout began answering nothing where a number was asked of it
